description: Swigs Cloud puts your project online in a single sentence. Give it a GitHub repository: the connector detects the framework, builds the project and publishes it over HTTPS on servers located Switzerland. You can then check the status of your sites, read deployment logs, manage environment variables and roll back to a previous version without leaving the conversation. Your data never leaves Swiss territory, backups included, and prices are in Swiss francs.

defaultPrompt: Irreversible deletion: the site is taken offline, its Kubernetes resources and its logs are erased. No restoration is possible.
What is the status of my site deployment?
Show me the logs from the last deployment
